name: Università degli Studi di Palermo
research_summary: Reviewed the sole legacy MSc candidate individually. Official 2026/27 offer lists Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (LM-18), with English delivery and historical requirements. Official 2027/28 subject assignments are evidence of teaching only; first-year intake is not confirmed. The international FAQ expressly says exact 2027/28 application dates are unpublished. Fee and scholarship material remains 2026/27; document and deadline discrepancies are recorded. The course regulation is explicitly for 2025/26, although the undated profile repeats its B2 English and curricular routes. Prior-cycle international MSc windows were 15 January–15 March and 15 April–20 July 2026; the first call was free. Foreign-resident non-EU tuition options in 2026/27 were country tariffs of €211/€267/€378 or an income-based route, with €156 fixed tax/stamp charges plus a variable contribution. ERSU benefits depend on income, merit, student classification and available funding. Official second-instalment dates conflict between 29 and 31 December 2026, and the fee-regulation index points to an older PDF than its label states.

application_deadlines.notes: The official FAQ explicitly says exact 2027/28 dates have not yet been published. The 2026/27 calendar is retained as historical context only.
